description: NaV₂O₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.85 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-2.01 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-2.00 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two V atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂V₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom.
